mechanism: Ginkgo biloba inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing buspirone plasma concentrations; additionally, ginkgo may potentiate serotonergic effects and increase bleeding risk through platelet inhibition.
action: Monitor for increased buspirone adverse effects (dizziness, drowsiness); consider dose reduction or increased monitoring; counsel patient on bleeding precautions and assess bleeding risk before combined use.
